title: Grocery list
description: Structured grocery list input for the instacart-shopper skill. Designed to be the natural output of an upstream meal-planning skill or any tool that already has structured ingredient data.

store.description: Name of the Instacart-supported store to shop at (e.g., 'Wegmans', 'Food Lion', 'Harris Teeter'). If omitted, the skill will ask the user upfront.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the list as a whole (e.g., 'weekly groceries', 'dinner party Saturday'). Not used for shopping decisions.

name.description: Item name (e.g., 'chicken breast', 'milk', '2% milk', 'organic baby spinach'). Be as specific as you'd like; the skill will ask for clarification on ambiguous items.

quantity.description: Numeric quantity. Combined with 'unit' if specified. Defaults to 1 if omitted (with the standard unit Instacart presents).

unit.description: Unit of measure (e.g., 'lb', 'oz', 'gal', 'each', 'dozen', 'loaf'). Optional; the skill will use Instacart's default unit if omitted.

notes.description: Free-form notes about this item (e.g., 'medium heat', 'no nuts', 'organic preferred'). The skill will use these as soft preferences during search.

brand.description: Optional brand preference. The skill will try to find this brand first; if unavailable, it falls back to the substitution policy.
